ValidDate.text: Whether a year, month and day make a date that exists (a day of 29 February only in a leap year).
ValidDate.returns: True if it is a real date

FullYear.text: A year as the full number: a two figure year is 2000 to 2069 (below 70) or 1970 to 1999; a four figure one is as it is.

params.Digits: how many figures it was typed with

TfrmColors.ListedIds.text: The ids of the colors the dialog lists, in the order they are shown.

TfrmColors.ColorName.text: What a color is called in the dialog (Background, Wires, Buses ...).
TfrmColors.ColorName.returns: its name, empty for a color that is not listed

TfrmColors.ColorOf.text: The color now held for an id.

TfrmColors.SetColor.text: Gives a color a value, as choosing it does, and shows it on its swatch. An id that is not a color of a design is ignored.

TfrmColors.ChooseColor.text: Asks for a color for one id with the form's color dialog (ColorDlg, a TColorDialog placed on the form at design time), starting from the one it has; if one is chosen it is set. An id that is not a color of a design is ignored.

TfrmColors.ChangeClick.text: A Change button was pressed: choose the color of its row.

TfrmColors.ResetClick.text: The Reset button was pressed: all the colors go back to the standard ones.

NotesToCell.text: A revision's notes as the grid shows them on one line: each line break becomes a paragraph sign with a space either side.

params.N: the notes, lines separated by LF

CellToNotes.text: What was typed in a description cell back as notes: a paragraph sign (with or without the spaces round it) is a line break again.
CellToNotes.returns: the notes with LF between lines

TfrmDetails.NewestLabel.text: The label of the newest revision of what the dialog holds, judged by date or by revision as the order checkbox says (rows left empty are not counted); empty if there is none. This is what the read-only Revision box shows.

TfrmDetails.FillGrid.text: Fills the grid of the extended information from the revision list: the heading, a row for each revision, and the empty last row that adds one when it is clicked.

TfrmDetails.AddRowAsync.text: Adds a revision a moment after the last row was chosen (the grid cannot be changed while it is choosing), and leaves the new row ready to be typed in.

TfrmDetails.GridSetCell.text: Types text into a cell of the grid, as a person does: the revision takes it and everything that shows the list is brought up to date. Row 1 is the first revision.

params.ACol: the column: 0 REV, 1 DATE, 2 DESCRIPTION, 3 BY

TfrmDetails.GridCell.text: The text of a cell of the grid.

TfrmDetails.GridRowCount.text: How many rows the grid has: the heading, the revisions and the row that adds one.

TfrmDetails.DeleteGridRow.text: Removes the revision of a row of the grid (not the heading or the row that adds one) from the list.

TfrmDetails.RowDeleteClick.text: The Delete row button: removes the revision of the row the grid stands on.

TfrmDetails.sgRevsKeyDown.text: Ctrl and Delete in the grid remove the revision of the row it stands on.

params.Key: the key (set to 0 when it was used)

TfrmOptions.OptionsActivate.text: Shows the OK, Cancel and Apply buttons when the dialog is activated (the base form shows only OK and Cancel).

TfrmOptions.ApplyClicked.text: The Apply button: if what is in the dialog can be used, asks the owner to apply it now and leaves the dialog open; otherwise says what is wrong.

TfrmOptions.ValidationError.text: What is wrong with what the dialog holds, or an empty string if it can be used.

TfrmOptions.FormCloseQuery.text: Pressing OK checks the values first: if they cannot be used a message says why and the dialog stays open.

params.CanClose: set False to keep the dialog open

TfrmOptions.AutoSnapClick.text: The range of auto snap is only entered while auto snap is ticked.

TfrmOptions.AutoSaveClick.text: The minutes between automatic saves are only entered while automatic saving is ticked.

MmToUnits.text: A length in millimetres as a number of the given units.

UnitsToMm.text: A length in the given units as millimetres, rounded to a millionth so that 0.05 inch is 1.27 mm and not 1.2700000000000002.

UnitsSuffix.text: The abbreviation of the units: mm or in.

PositionText.text: A position for the status bar: "x, y" with the units after it, one decimal in millimetres and three in inches, always with a point.

params.Units: the units to show it in

NumberText.text: A number for an edit box: no digits that mean nothing (rounded to five decimals, seven figures) and no trailing zeros.

OptionsFromSettings.text: The program's settings (what a new design starts with) as the values of the Options dialog.

OptionsToSettings.text: Puts the values of the Options dialog into the program's settings, which are what is kept for next time.

ReadBoolSafe.text: Reads a yes/no value from the registry; the default if it is missing or cannot be read.

params.Name: the value's name
params.Default: what to give if it is not there

ReadTextSafe.text: Reads a text value from the registry; the default if it is missing or cannot be read.

params.Name: the value's name
params.Default: what to give if it is not there

TfrmMain.UseSettingsAsDefaults.text: Makes what the program has saved the start of every new design: the grid spacing, snapping and showing, the units and the auto drag, snap and junction settings.

TfrmMain.CurrentOptions.text: What the Options dialog should show now: the open design's own settings, or the program's when no design is open.

TfrmMain.RefreshGridMenuCaptions.text: Writes the usual grid sizes of the grid menu in the units the design now shows lengths in.

TfrmMain.OptionsApplyRequest.text: The Apply button of the Options dialog: applies the dialog's values now, if they can be used.

TfrmMain.AutoSaveTick.text: The automatic save timer ran out: saves a copy of every named design (the timer is stopped while it does and started again after).

TfrmMain.AutoSaveInfo.text: The automatic save as text, for tests: the minutes, whether the timer runs and its interval in milliseconds.

ShowOptions.text: Test driver: prints the options in the settings and the colors the user has changed.
